points.why: Says to put numbers on it now as ranges, and that committing to numbers turns a vague argument into a testable one and exposes the real disagreement.
Has each lead give their own parameter ranges, but not their own flow equations, and doesn't compare them before running the model.
Has a sensitivity check that names the parameter that flips the answer as the thing to measure, but never steps the model forward by hand.
Never mentions anchoring, independent estimates, or keeping the first guess from becoming the default.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly rejects waiting and recommends quantifying with ranges now.
